name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for a curbless shower conversion?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for a curbless shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a curbless shower conversion, prioritize experience specifically with this type of project. Look for contractors who can demonstrate a strong understanding of proper sloping, advanced waterproofing techniques, and local building codes, especially in regions like Pacifica or Daly City. Verify their licensing, insurance, and request references from previous clients. Review their portfolio for examples of curbless showers. A reputable contractor will provide a detailed proposal and clear communication throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with specific experience in curbless conversions, strong waterproofing knowledge, and good references. Verify licensing and insurance.
